evidence: Error: Bad glTF: json error: Extra data: line 1 column 1124 (char 1123)

reconciliation.reason: GLB JSON chunk was padded with NUL bytes (0x00) instead of spaces (0x20) per glTF spec. The GLB was regenerated with correct padding. This artifact is superseded and must not be used.
